mods.title: Call of darkness V2 V Slice
mods.description: This is a fan port of the *Call of Darkness V2* mod for Mobile/VSlice.-Credits-VSlice Team:-Juxz (Me) - Coder and Porter (Songs)-Guxtav - Coder (Menu,Loading,Death Screen)-Breninho - Coder (HUD)Original Description:This mod is based on Bendy and the Dark Revival, built on PE 0.6.3. It features 8 regular songs and 1 hidden song (Can you find it?).Main Story:BF and GF accidentally end up in this mysterious world. Because of their nature as "outsiders," the "Administrator," who has been watching from the shadows, grants them each a corresponding ability.BF's ability: He can stun nearby creatures with his voice, and sustained output can kill lesser monsters. He must have a microphone to activate it.GF's ability: She can briefly wield the power of color, at the cost of shortening her own lifespan (especially effective against demons).To return to their original world, the two have no choice but to search for a way back while fighting to survive.They know the abilities each has been given, and because of the dangerous nature of hers, BF has warned GF never to use it unless her life is in danger.Relying on each other, they survive in this strange world for a long time, until one day.While wandering around, BF and GF encounter Little Bendy. Driven by his competitive spirit, BF starts a rap battle with him. BF wins with no surprise, and in his excitement, he tosses his microphone toward Little Bendy. Little Bendy fails to catch it, gets hit and dazed, and runs away in hurt and sadness.BF wants to apologize, so he impulsively chases after him, getting separated from GF in the process. During the pursuit, a group of Lost Ones block his path and try to extort money from him. Confident in his ability, BF isn't afraid of these thugs and is about to teach them a lesson. Suddenly, a figure descends from above—it is the most dangerous creature in this world, the "Ink Demon." The leader of the Lost Ones is instantly crushed into a pulp. BF uses his ability to stun the demon and flees in panic. The demon then turns to the few remaining Lost Ones, who are collapsed on the ground in terror.All that is left of them are the fading echoes of their screams.BF runs all the way to the subway station, hoping to escape by train. But with a roar, the demon catches up.As BF confronts it with his ability, the train arrives. He seizes the chance to jump aboard, and a nightmarish chase with the Ink Demon begins. In the end, BF uses his power to repel the demon and narrowly escapes. The demon, however, leaves him with a chilling threat: no one in this place can escape its hunt.BF is feeling relieved to have survived, but he is still separated from GF. As he wonders how to find her, he passes by a detention cell and sees a mysterious man imprisoned inside. He tries to ask if the man has seen GF or knows where she went, but gets no answers. Just as he is about to leave, a sudden chill runs down his spine.The Ink Demon has caught up...After a standoff, BF tries to stun the demon with his ability, only to find, to his horror, that it no longer works...Just as the Ink Demon is about to hunt BF, its body suddenly erupts in colorful light, vibrant and rich with color. GF has arrived. The demon, struggling, transforms back into Little Bendy and then leaves.BF is stunned. He never imagined that the seemingly harmless Little Bendy was actually the Ink Demon all along, and he realizes that GF just used her ability—not for herself, but for him. He is about to scold her when she suddenly throws her arms around him and says, "I don't want to lose you." BF freezes.The two fall silent.

mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
